Which statement is true about an open systems model of public relations in an organization?
Option A: It adapts to changing organizational environments.
Option B: It adopts the policy of transparency to build public trust.
Option C: It focuses on removing communication barriers between its business divisions.
Option D: It communicates with its publics frequently to effect change outside the organization.
